metric: RESULT offloop_jobs_rooms_{idle,done,aborted}_{baseline,mutant}: off-loop sysid jobs (coordinator._await_off_loop: a process-worker round trip) per _run_system_identification with no active experiment, indoor and outdoor entities configured; behaviour_differs_* compares the adopted action and the experiment state
inputs: phases IDLE, DONE, ABORTED, ARMED x configs default (hold_reason stands down) and indoor+outdoor entities
null: phase ARMED (the guard not taken): 1 job in both arms; default config: 0 jobs in both arms
should: tests/features.py ~24718 drives _run_system_identification on the executor route but never counts the off-loop dispatches of an inactive experiment; tests/deployment_shape.py checks where step_detached runs, not how often. No check asserts that an idle experiment ships nothing to the worker
title: An idle system-identification experiment can ship a process-worker job every cycle and the gate passes
claim: HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator._run_system_identification (coordinator.py:11057) may lose its `if not self._sysid.active: return` guard and the full gate passes; behaviour is unchanged (SystemIdentification.step returns None and stand_down/abort return at once when inactive), but on an install with indoor and outdoor sensors every cycle then dispatches one off-loop step_detached job (probe: 0 -> 1 per cycle), a pickled experiment round trip to the process worker that the Raspberry-Pi-class host pays for nothing.
direction: off-loop jobs per idle cycle 0 -> 1 (cost up; behaviour equal)
